brand.kicker: DJ FOLSOE on Twitch · Broadcast Cloud
about.title: Who is DJ FOLSOE?
about.body: DJ FOLSOE is a Danish Music TV universe on Twitch with live DJ shows, song requests, Top 20 countdowns, community and Danish DJ culture. The channel blends radio energy, TV graphics and chat-driven entertainment.
shows.title: Shows
shows.body: Recurring and special shows directly from Broadcast Cloud.
news.title: News and info
news.body: No tickers on the homepage — clickable cards show show updates, Top 20, requests, community and Twitch updates.
top20.title: FOLSOE Top 20
top20.body: The weekly chart can be opened and used for countdown shows.
mods.title: Mod team
mods.body: Mods help chat, welcome new viewers and protect the good vibe.
